metadata-ocr.group-description: Optional shortcut after document uploads: suggest metadata values from readable text. Nothing is saved until the person submits.
metadata-ocr.section-description: AI reads supported documents (images, PDF, simple text files) and suggests matching metadata values you can accept or edit.
metadata-ocr.enabled-description: When enabled, after someone chooses a supported document with metadata fields, they are asked whether to run AI extraction. Declining keeps the empty metadata form; accepting fills suggestions they can edit before submit.

metadata-ocr.assist-id-description: Choose which assist reads the file and maps it to your fields. Leave blank to use the tenant default from AI settings.
